title: Loses power & first responders stop traffic
video:
<video id="video" playsinline autoplay muted loop><source src="media/video4.mp4" type="video/mp4"/>
</video>
desc:
Dali loses power for the third and final time before the crash, and puts out a distress call.

First repsonders call to stop traffic on the bridge, saying, "I need one of you guys on the south side, one of you guys on the north side. Hold all traffic on the Key Bridge. There's a ship approaching that just lost their steering."

Listen to the audio of a first responder below. Source: Broadcastify

title: Hits bridge
video:
<video id="video" playsinline autoplay muted loop><source src="media/video5.mov" type="video/mp4"/>
</video>
desc:
After slowing to about 1.5 knots (less than two mph), the ship hits the bridge, causing the collapse. The crash was more than a football field's length away from where ships typically cross under the bridge.

One first responder exclaimed, "The whole bridge just fell down!"

Listen to the audio of a first responder below. Source: Broadcastify
